subject: Operations
title: Amazon Reinvents Fulfillment
description: A micro-lesson that makes Amazon Reinvents Fulfillment usable.

hook.text: Amazon's warehouses don't organize by category. Toothpaste sits next to textbooks. It looks insane—but it's genius.

buildup.text: Algorithms track every item's location. Random storage maximizes space; robots fetch items for packers.

discovery.text: Amazon redefined operations with chaotic storage, predictive stocking, and same-day delivery infrastructure.

twist.text: Their operations became so good it became a product itself—Amazon Web Services was born from internal tools.

climax.text: Fulfillment centers process over a million packages daily. Operations is Amazon's true competitive moat.

quiz.question: How does Amazon organize items in its warehouses?
